name: Nim Game
statement: Two players Alice and Bob are playing a game. They have n piles. ith pile conatins arr[i] no. of coins. In each move a player can choose a pile and remove as many coins as he wants (minimum 1 coin). The player who removes the last set of coins from table will win. Alice goes first.
inputFormat:
The first line contains integer n, no. of piles.
second line contains n integer containing number of coins in each pile.
